dedupe_keys.name: bidirectional testing of drywall partition walls with novel details integrated into a rocking wall subassembly

description: Bidirectional Testing of Drywall Partition Walls with Novel Details, Integrated into a Rocking Wall Subassembly is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Keri Ryan, University of Nevada Reno (unr.edu). Two different configurations of drywall partition walls were built within a post-tensioned CLT rocking wall subassembly. The overarching objective is to investigate the seismic performance of drywall partition walls when integrated with a rocking wall system, and to assess the influence of out-of-plane loading on the in-plane resistance of the walls. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Tall Wood, CLT, Cross Laminated Timber. Published 2021-10-07. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
